answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 9565 Country: OM Title: It is gud to sleep in wuzu.i do my wuzu and go to sleep .i read the three quls and then ayat kursi and when i lay down to sleep i feel to fart (pass the aiir).do i have to do my wozo again if i fart or the first wozo was enough.i will get the reward all night or not? Question: Salam,it is gud to sleep in wuzu.i do my wuzu and go to sleep .i read the three quls and then ayat kursi and when i lay down to sleep i feel to fart (pass the aiir).do i have to do my wozo again if i fart or the first wozo was enough.i will get the reward all night or not? Answer ID: 9565 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2518/2081=B/1429) There is no need to remake the wudhu . In both the cases, whether the wudhu remains or breaks off, you shall get the reward of all night. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
